definition_zh: 经纪业务；经纪公司；佣金，回扣
definition_en: the business of a broker; a firm of brokers; the fee a broker charges
core_image: 中间人一手牵买家一手牵卖家，从成交里抽一小截
scene: 交易大厅里电话声此起彼伏，报价屏不停闪烁。Her brokerage handled trades for two hundred clients.
sceneCN: 这里 brokerage 是「经纪公司」（第 2 个义项：经营代理买卖业务的公司）；句意是她所在的经纪公司为两百名客户打理交易。

pos.zh: 经纪业务；经纪公司；经纪人佣金

derivatives.zh: brokerage 的基础词，义为「经纪人；掮客」
由 broker 加 -ship 构成，义为「经纪身份；经纪行当（罕用）」
由动词加 -ing 构成，义为「居间撮合的行为」

senses.title: The broker's business
senses.definition: the trade of acting as an agent between buyers and sellers
senses.definitionCN: 在买卖双方之间居间代理的业务
senses.example: The firm moved from banking into brokerage.
senses.exampleCN: 这家公司从银行业转入了经纪业务。
senses.why: The agent suffix -age turns the broker into his line of work.
senses.whyCN: 集体或行为后缀 -age 把经纪人转成他的业务行当。

senses.title: A firm of brokers
senses.definition: a company whose business is brokerage
senses.definitionCN: 经营经纪业务的公司机构
senses.example: She opened an account at a discount brokerage.
senses.exampleCN: 她在一家折扣券商开了账户。
senses.why: A business name easily becomes the name of the business place.
senses.whyCN: 业务的名称顺势转指经营这项业务的机构。

senses.title: The broker's fee
senses.definition: the fee or commission charged for arranging a deal
senses.definitionCN: 为撮合交易而收取的酬金
senses.example: The deal cost them a hefty brokerage.
senses.exampleCN: 这笔交易让他们付了一笔可观的佣金。
senses.why: -age also names payment for a service, like postage orstorage.
senses.whyCN: -age 也可表服务酬金，如 postage、storage 之类。

intro.en: Brokerage is broker plus -age, and broker itself comes from an Old French word for small trader.
intro.cn: brokerage 由 broker 加 -age 构成，broker 则源自古法语指小贩的词。

items.en: broceour meant a small trader, wine seller or retailer.
items.cn: 古法语 broceour 指小贩、酒贩或零售商。

items.en: brocour crossed into England with the wine trade.
items.cn: 随酒业传入英格兰，词形作 brocour。

items.en: broker meant a middleman in trade, at first with a hint of trickery.
items.cn: 十四世纪英语 broker 指居间商人，起初略带贬义。

items.en: brokerage formed on broker with the -age suffix for business and fees.
items.cn: 十六至十七世纪以 broker 加 -age 构成 brokerage，兼指业务与佣金。

items.en: brokerage now names firms, accounts and fees in finance and property.
items.cn: 如今 brokerage 用于金融与地产，指券商、账户与佣金。

note.en: Brokerage belongs to the world of agents and middlemen.
note.cn: brokerage 属于代理与居间业务的世界。

entries.definition: an agent who buys and sells for others
the act of arranging deals as a broker
the fee or act of storing
entries.definitionCN: 仓储（费）——同为 -age 表费用，词根不同

entries.definition: the business of acting for others; an agent's firm
a fee paid as a percentage of a sale
a trader who buys and sells on his own account
a person who acts between two parties

normalIntro.en: Stack the word: broker plus age equals the broker's business, firm and fee.
normalIntro.cn: 把词拆开记：broker 加 age，即经纪人的业务、公司与佣金。

normal.en: Broker + age: like postage, a fee word.
normal.cn: broker 加 -age，如 postage 一样可表费用。

normal.en: A brokerage account is where the broker works for you.
normal.cn: brokerage account 就是券商替你操作交易的账户。

normal.en: Real estate brokerage sells houses for a cut.
Dealer trades his own goods; broker trades yours.
normal.cn: dealer 卖自己的货，broker 卖你的货。

normal.en: Age here means business, not years.
normal.cn: 这里的 -age 表业务，与年龄无关。

abstract.en: See a middleman shaking two hands at once.
abstract.cn: 想象中间人同时握住两只手。

abstract.en: Watch a thin slice peel off every big deal.
abstract.cn: 看着每笔大交易上削下薄薄一片。

abstract.en: Hear ringing phones in a room full of screens.
abstract.cn: 听满屋屏幕间电话铃声大作。

examples.en: The brokerage earned a fee on every share traded.
examples.cn: 券商从每笔股票交易中抽取佣金。

examples.en: He left banking to open a small brokerage downtown.
examples.cn: 他离开银行业，在市中心开了家小经纪行。

examples.en: They cut brokerage costs by trading online.
examples.cn: 他们改做线上交易以省下经纪费。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「不若亏之」——中间人劝你：「不若亏之」，亏他一点佣金，买卖才成。

root: brokerage 由 broker（经纪人）加 -age（业务、费用）构成；broker 源自古法语 broceour／brocour（小贩、酒商），更早词源不确定，或与灌木丛（broce）中摆摊的零售者有关，属存疑假说。

sensesIntro.en: The -age suffix spreads one root across the business, the firm and the fee.
sensesIntro.cn: 一个 -age 后缀，让同一个词根覆盖了业务、公司和佣金三义。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a middleman taking a thin slice of the deal.
core.cn: 核心意象：中间人从成交中抽走薄薄一片。

intro.en: The family is small: the agent, his act, his status and his business.
intro.cn: 词族不大：经纪人、其行为、其身份、其业务。

latinIntro.en: The trail is French and possibly older still, ending in uncertainty.
latinIntro.cn: 词源经法语上溯，更早来源不确定。

items.meaning: an agent for buyers and sellers

items.meaningCN: 表业务、费用或集合的后缀
经纪业务；经纪公司；佣金

items.exampleCN: 他的经纪资格失效（罕用）

items.meaning: a person who deals in influence
